description: A false tag antecedent does not evaluate the restored query in its consequent (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(X)
%conditions ~recursive ⊆ tags($x, q)
%rule q $y(r)
%tags tags($y) ∪ (text($) = "wrong" ⟹ tags(without-elision($y), rival))
%rule r r [+U] <~recursive> | X <∅>
%rule rival X
